title.zh: Runway用互联网视频训机器人，效果几乎追平专业数据
title.en: Runway用互联网视频训机器人，效果几乎追平专业数据

current_state.zh: Runway unveiled Praxis-1, a robot model pretrained on ordinary internet video that nearly matches teleoperation-data training on an object-placement benchmark while transferring across multiple robot hardware platforms.
current_state.en: Runway unveiled Praxis-1, a robot model pretrained on ordinary internet video that nearly matches teleoperation-data training on an object-placement benchmark while transferring across multiple robot hardware platforms.
